claims.text: The source defines T2I-Adapter: lightweight adapter (~77M; small 18M, tiny 5M) injecting 4-scale features into a frozen SD encoder, cubic timestep sampling emphasising early steps; weighted adapter sums at inference with no retraining, generalising to SD1.4/1.5 derivatives.
Reported numbers: COCO FID 16.78 (seg) / 17.36 (sketch) vs PITI 19.36/21.21 vs SD 24.68; CLIP 0.2652/0.2666; 10 epochs batch-8 on 4xV100 ~3 days; encoder-injection placement best (FID 17.36).

limitations.text: Multi-adapter fusion manual; coarse free-hand sketch variance.
